title: What Animals Need to Survive
seo_title: Year 2 Science: What Animals Need Worksheets (Water, Food and Air)
standard_text: Find out about and describe the basic needs of animals, including humans, for survival (water, food and air).
meta_desc: Free Year 2 science worksheets on what animals need to survive: water, food and air, how animals breathe, caring for pets and how wild animals find food. 100 questions with answers.
key_sub: All animals, including humans, need these to stay alive.
body_html:
How to think about it

All animals need water, food and air.

  • Humans are animals too.
  • Fish take air from the water with gills.
  • Pets need people to give them food and water.
Example

Which need is most urgent?

Minutes without it

Answer: air

Example

How does a fish get air?

From the water

Answer: with gills

Common mistakes

  • Thinking fish do not need air.
  • Thinking animals only need food.
  • Thinking pets can look after themselves.

faq.q: What do animals need to survive?
faq.a: All animals, including humans, need water, food and air.
Yes. Fish take air from the water using their gills.

faq.q: How do we look after a pet?
faq.a: Give it fresh water, the right food, a clean home with air, and check on it every day.
